title: The Second Promise
author: Juniper Villalobos
blurb: Jonah Delacroix, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
